exceptions.bounded_scope: 11 source practice questions at basis 2516: six easy, five moderate; canonical example supports easy only
exceptions.reason: No observed hard workload or separately validated hard extension. Increasing dimension, introducing dependent parameter vectors or changing the requested invariant would add workload or alter the recovered backbone.
exceptions.reopen_when: New source evidence or a separately authorized and validated same-KP hard workload

domains.easy: m=2..7, n=4..12, 1<=k<=min(m,n-1), valid complete bank profile; integer dimensions
domains.moderate: four vector components, two parameters x2,x3 or three parameters x1,x2,x3; integer coefficients -3..3, full column rank

finite_limits.easy: 53 distinct (n,k) tasks, verified by exhaustive easy parameter/profile enumeration; row count and bank changes do not add tasks.
finite_limits.moderate: Finite coefficient domain; quotient by equal rational column spaces using transpose RREF. No claim of exhaustive count.

distinctness_policy: Easy ignores the irrelevant row count, bank, seed and identities; moderate identifies equal null spaces even with different parameter bases. Inline/display and choice-bank changes alone never create fresh tasks.
future_exhaustion: Search at most 80 seeded candidates per supported level per replenishment; if distinct available reserve remains below five, report finite-limit with remaining supported shortage. Never mint identities to bypass exhaustion.
plot_requirements: none; all source matrices are LaTeX mathematical expressions, not plot assets
